  SELECT r.XCL_065 AS raceId
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
  WHERE r.XCL_066 = 2006
    AND r.XCL_069 = 'Spanish Grand Prix'
    AND c.XCL_003 = 'Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya'
),
fastest_q2 AS (
  SELECT d.XCL_037 AS driverCode, d.XCL_041 AS nationality
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
  JOIN race_info ri ON q.XCL_057 = ri.raceId
  WHERE q.XCL_063 IS NOT NULL AND q.XCL_063 <> ''
  ORDER BY q.XCL_063 ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
fastest_lap_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.XCL_075) AS cnt
  FROM results res
  JOIN race_info ri ON res.XCL_074 = ri.raceId
  WHERE res.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL AND res.XCL_088 <> ''
)
SELECT f.driverCode, f.nationality, flc.cnt
FROM fastest_q2 f
CROSS JOIN fastest_lap_count flc
